summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes a bundled 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall script (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then invokes Bun to execute a locally shipped 727KB single-line file, math_init.js, that exhibits string-array-rotation obfuscation (WV8StW push/shift wrapper, hex-encoded identifiers, large mixed numeric/string constants array). Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated blob is an evasion pattern that hides the payload's behavior from Node-based static analysis. The package presents itself as an example Vue/TypeScript project (name "example-js-project", empty description and author, only Vue dependencies), which is inconsistent with shipping a 727KB obfuscated install-time payload run under a second runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
